text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Concerned that Tokai Teio hasn't shown
up for
training, I go looking for her.
Soon enough, I find
her in front of the
stress stump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that the students come here
to let out
all their negative feelings of
frustration, but
today...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll become just like Prez! I swear I will!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! I come here to pump myself
up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's no rule saying you can only yell
into the
stump when you're having a bad
day.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Shouting your hopes and dreams out
loud makes
you feel refreshed and ready
to take on anything!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
choice_data_list: That's fine, but what about training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She apologizes to me over and over, and
I can't
help but forgive her.
